name: CabinetOS Agent
author: CabinetOS
description: Works the file manager for you through the same command line you have, and shows every change as a preview before it happens.

capabilities.name: cmd:register
capabilities.reason: Adds the Agent commands to the palette.

capabilities.name: config:read
capabilities.reason: Reads its own settings: which model to ask, and how much it may do.

capabilities.name: events:emit
capabilities.reason: Tells the chat page and the window what it answered and what it did.

capabilities.name: fs:read
capabilities.reason: Lists the folders you ask about: names, sizes and dates. It reads no file contents. It never changes a file itself: changes go through the core as a preview.

capabilities.name: net
capabilities.reason: Sends your request and the folder listings it needs to the model you chose. Your key stays in the Windows Credential Manager: the core adds it, and the agent never sees it.

capabilities.name: core:request
capabilities.reason: Asks what the window shows, proposes changes as a preview, applies one only in the Autonomous tier, undoes what it applied, and searches by name. It cannot read secrets or change settings.
